errors.text_span: The second largest, in teal, is "VITAMINC" at 13.0%
errors.evidence: This statement contains two errors. First, the second largest slice is FEVER at 16.1%, not VITAMINC at 13.0%. Second, the teal-colored slice represents FEVER, not VITAMINC (which is aquamarine).

The description implies SNLI is the third-largest slice, following VITAMINC. However, SNLI (15.4%) is larger than VITAMINC (13.0%) and is the third-largest slice overall, while VITAMINC is the fourth.
The description incorrectly states that MULTIFC contributes 11.3% to the total. According to the chart, MULTIFC's contribution is 0.5%.
The slice corresponding to MULTIFC is colored light blue, not light teal. The light teal (aquamarine) slice corresponds to VITAMINC.
The slice corresponding to FEVER is colored teal, not dark orange. The dark orange slice corresponds to ANLI.
The slice corresponding to SCIFACT is colored light blue, not yellow. The yellow/gold slice corresponds to ENTFA.
The slice corresponding to ENTFA is colored yellow/gold, not green. The green slice corresponds to FACTCC.
The slice corresponding to ANLI is colored orange, not brown.
The slice corresponding to PUBHEALTH is colored light green, not purple. There is no purple slice in the chart.
